text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management. Start by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and setting your own mini-deadlines. Prioritization is also key: decide which tasks are most important and focus on them first. If you realize you cannot finish everything, use scope management. This means reducing what you planned to do so the most essential parts are completed. Finally, communication matters. Tell your manager, team, or client early if a deadline is at risk, and explain your plan. They can often help or adjust expectations. With these four skills, deadlines become much easier to manage.
